# JavaScript Quirks & Engine Internals Guide
> An authoritative reference and interactive learning engine for ECMAScript 2026 specifications, JavaScript engine internals (V8/SpiderMonkey), type coercion, event loop execution, and interview challenges.

- [#15 3Sum (Medium)](https://javascript-quirks.ai.studio/#view=leetcode): Sorting + Two Pointers. Category: Two Pointers.
- [#53 Maximum Subarray (Medium)](https://javascript-quirks.ai.studio/#view=leetcode): Kadane's Algorithm (Dynamic Programming). Category: Dynamic Programming.

- [#2629 Function Composition (Easy)](https://javascript-quirks.ai.studio/#view=leetcode): Functional Programming / Reduce Right. Category: JavaScript & Async.
- [#146 LRU Cache (Medium)](https://javascript-quirks.ai.studio/#view=leetcode): Doubly Linked List + Hash Map / JS Map Ordering. Category: Arrays & Hash Maps.
- [#206 Reverse Linked List (Easy)](https://javascript-quirks.ai.studio/#view=leetcode): Pointer Manipulation (Iterative 3-Pointers). Category: Linked Lists.
